network_status.network: Rapporto di evento meteoidrologico del 20-21 ottobre 2013
network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ARPAL documenta il cedimento del pilone del ponte di Carasco e pubblica 5,13 m alla stazione Lavagna-Carasco e 4,06 m sull'Entella a Panesi. Il record riguarda però il ponte sullo Sturla: i livelli dei corsi riceventi non vengono trasferiti alla sezione del tributario.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPAL report documents pier failure at the Carasco bridge and publishes 5.13 m at Lavagna-Carasco and 4.06 m on the Entella at Panesi. The record, however, concerns the Sturla bridge; receiving-river stages are not transferred to the tributary section.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
